# Kevin O'Connell

Kevin O'Connell has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Deputies Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [District 4](https://flow.je/elections/district-4), representing [Reform Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/reform-jersey). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/21/healthcare-on-agenda-for-st-helier-north-and-reform-jersey-candidate/)\]
